text:
The Lake Wind Advisory is up, so if you're heading onto the waterfront, expect a sunny but increasingly breezy afternoon. Burlington is sitting near 68 with a south wind around 13 mph, and the temperature should climb into the mid to upper 70s. The air is dry and comfortable for now, with good air quality, and the afternoon looks like the best window for outdoor plans.

The turn comes tonight. Winds on the lake build to 20 to 30 knots, with waves reaching 3 to 5 feet, while showers become likely after midnight. Sunday starts wet, then stays unsettled with more showers and a chance of thunderstorms, especially in the afternoon. The models disagree on how wet Sunday gets, but the European model is the wetter outlier, so I'd carry the rain jacket. Enjoy the lake or a long walk this afternoon, but be off the broad water before evening and keep Sunday plans flexible.

week.blurb: Sunny and breezy, near 77, then rain likely after midnight; plan daytime outdoors, not a late-night walk.
Morning showers, then a mostly cloudy Sunday near 79 with thunderstorms possible and rain chances lingering into evening.
A cool, mostly sunny Monday near 68 follows an early shower chance, though temperatures could run several degrees cooler.
Mostly sunny and mild near 71, with daytime plans looking good before a chance of showers arrives after dark.
Partly sunny and warm near 77, with only a small early shower chance and another slight chance overnight.
A mostly cloudy Thursday near 77 brings the week's steadiest shower risk, with rain possible through the day.
Friday turns mostly sunny near 72, with a smaller shower chance early and a mostly dry evening near 52.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - It started off quite chilly and foggy with temperatures in the 30s and 40s. The rest of today will be a beautiful day with mostly sunny skies. Temperatures will quickly rise into the mid to upper 70s, making for a great day to be outdoors. A low pressure to our south will bring some showers to southern sections late Saturday night. This combined with an approaching cold front from the west will keep scattered showers around on Sunday. There is the chance for an afternoon thunderstorm. It will be breezy and more humid with highs in the 70s.
